propositions: Rich-text encoding is hardwired to ADF in Cloud path while Data Center uses plain text/wiki markup, causing duplication when implementing both paths

A RichTextCodec Protocol with four operations (fit_outbound, normalize_outbound, to_wire, decode_inbound) must replace separate Cloud and DC implementations while preserving existing behavior-pinning composition order
AdfCodec must live in adapters/jira/ and WikiTextCodec in adapters/jira_family/ to enforce the import contract that jira_family imports nothing from Cloud vendor modules

map_fields_to_remote must be unified into a single implementation at adapters/jira_family/outbound_mapper.py taking RichTextCodec as a constructor dependency, with Cloud and DC constructed with their respective codecs

WikiTextCodec truncates at 32767 characters with marker ' … [truncated by reconciler]' (same as ADF marker for consistency), while AdfCodec's fit_outbound performs binary search on ADF serialization size
Cloud's two call paths (one composing fit+normalize, one fit-only via sanitizer) must remain distinguishable to avoid silent behavior change or diff convergence loss
